verdict.rationale: Two independent probes confirm a live, keyless llms.txt at docs.skyfire.xyz, which describes Skyfire as the identity and payments layer for AI agents. Every docs and API reference page is also served as a raw .md URL, so an agent can be pointed straight at agent-readable documentation. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed OpenAPI/Swagger paths returned 404) and evidence of an llms-full.txt or of how complete the llms.txt index is.
